pain_point: Fear of buying at the wrong time - What if the market drops after I buy? Should I wait for rates to come down?
headline_pain: Should You Wait for Rates to Drop?
headline_outcome: Buy Now. Settle When It's Built.
primary_text: "Should I wait for rates to come down?" While you wait, rent goes up, prices go up, and you fall further behind. Off-the-plan buying gives you a unique advantage: you secure your warehouse at today's price with just a deposit. You don't settle until construction completes — giving rates time to move while your price stays locked. Hundreds of Melbourne business owners have used this exact strategy to get into ownership without the pressure of immediate repayments. New Truganina warehouses are available now for small business owner-occupiers. The best time to buy was yesterday. The second best time is today.
description: Deposit now, settle on completion — rates may drop before you pay
